items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I met her up there, but she began to move around.

ctx.x: Until he came here. When he came here that was sort of permanent. Stravinsky left home when he was twenty seven, I think that's when he did the "Firebird". One can do it then; that's easy. One becomes a world citizen, which is the way the world is now anyway. I remember, we grew up in Nyack and there were kids I grew up with who had never been to New York City; things were that regional. It wasn't exactly an isolation but there was no real reason to do that. Peg came from up northern Wisconsin. Once in a while…
a job in the Veterans Administration in Illinois. I met her up there, but she began to move around.
